title: Longer and longer we play at this game think the more we root #OER into the DNA of the web the more resilient the community and resources will be. #OE
summary: Longer and longer we play at this game think the more we root #OER into the DNA of the web the more resilient the community and resources will be. #OER communities come and go, so much time wasted on theoretical vocabularies never actually used.

body_html:
Longer and longer we play at this game think the more we root #OER into the DNA of the web the more resilient the community and resources will be.
